The '''2017–18 Marshall Thundering Herd men's basketball team''' represented the [[Marshall University]] during the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Thundering Herd, led by fourth-year head coach [[Dan D'Antoni]], played their home games at the [[Cam Henderson Center]] as members of [[Conference USA]]. They finished the season 25–11, 12–6 in C-USA play to finish in fourth place. They defeated [[2017–18 UTSA Roadrunners men's basketball team|UTSA]], [[2017–18 Southern Miss Golden Eagles basketball team|Southern Miss]], and [[2017–18 Western Kentucky Hilltoppers basketball team|Western Kentucky]] to become champions of the [[2018 Conference USA men's basketball tournament|C-USA tournament]]. They received C-USA's automatic bid to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where, as a No. 13 seed, they upset [[2017–18 Wichita State Shockers men's basketball team|Wichita State]] in the first round before losing to [[2017–18 West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball team|West Virginia]] in the second round.

==Previous season==
The [[2016–17 Marshall Thundering Herd men's basketball team|Thundering Herd]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 20–15, 10–8 in [[2016–17 Conference USA men's basketball season|C-USA play]] to finish in sixth place. They defeated [[2016–17 Florida Atlantic Owls men's basketball team|Florida Atlantic]], [[2016–17 Old Dominion Monarchs basketball team|Old Dominion]], and [[2016–17 Louisiana Tech Bulldogs basketball team|Louisiana Tech]] to advance to the championship game of the [[2017 Conference USA men's basketball tournament|C-USA tournament]]. There they lost to top-seeded [[2016–17 Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders men's basketball team|Middle Tennessee]]. Despite finishing with 20 wins, they did not participate in a postseason tournament.
